treatment: Apply tricyclazole-based fungicide (e.g. Beam 75WP) at first sign. Drain the field to reduce humidity.
prevention: Use resistant varieties (Bg 403, Bg 406). Avoid excess nitrogen fertilizer. Maintain proper spacing.

treatment: No cure for infected plants; remove and destroy them. Control whitefly vector with neem oil or imidacloprid.
prevention: Use virus-free seedlings, install yellow sticky traps, keep field weed-free.

treatment: Spray mancozeb or chlorothalonil every 7 days. Remove infected plants immediately.
prevention: Avoid overhead watering, ensure good drainage, rotate crops yearly.

treatment: Remove infected leaves and burn them. Apply propiconazole fungicide.
prevention: Improve air circulation between plants, avoid waterlogging, apply potassium-rich fertilizer.

treatment: Spray neem oil (2%) or approved acaricide on young bunches.
prevention: Field sanitation, remove fallen nuts, encourage predatory mites.
